issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and pre-referral workflows
issues.desc: Loan Simple leads were being enrolled in duplicate workflow branches, causing HAs and TCs to receive the same tasks twice. The root cause was a Hubspot bug related to association filters for LS leads. Hubspot support was engaged and confirmed the issue resolved.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or reconcile the duplicate tasks in HubSpot.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that previously fell through and went back under contract
issues.desc: When a deal was marked Offer Accepted, fell through, reverted to a prior stage, and then was marked Offer Accepted again, the TC assignment workflow did not re-enroll the deal because re-enrollment was not enabled. This caused TC tasks and closing info collection to not trigger on the second contract. The workflow was updated to allow re-enrollment.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any affected deals into the TC Assignment workflow and collect closing information directly from the agent.

issues.title: Loan officer change not reflected in automated emails — emails still showed previous LO
issues.desc: When a loan officer was changed on a deal, automated emails continued to display the previous LO's information instead of the updated one. The issue was identified as a product-side data sync problem. Luis resolved the issue.
issues.workaround: For any leads whose emails went out with the wrong LO during the impact window, manually send a corrected email with the accurate LO information.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: Deals marked as Closed Lost or Transferred were continuing to generate check-in tasks from the post-referral workflow instead of suppressing them. A filter tweak was applied to the workflow to resolve the issue.
issues.workaround: Manually delete any erroneous tasks that were generated after a deal was marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: MRC and other TC Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows not enrolling leads
issues.desc: Leads updated to Offer Accepted or Sale Pending stages — particularly MRC deals — were not enrolling into TC workflows, meaning TCs did not receive tasks for closing coordination. The issue affected leads from approximately February 26th through April 1st. Hubspot support was consulted and the issue was resolved.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any MRC or affected deals from the February 26 – April 1 impact window into the TC workflow and send closing info collection emails manually.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not triggered for referral accepted on March 18th due to data pull error
issues.desc: A referral accepted on March 18th did not generate any post-referral workflow tasks for the HA. The root cause was an error in how data was being pulled, which prevented the workflow filter from evaluating correctly. The issue was escalated to product.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll the affected deal into the post-referral workflow and complete any outstanding tasks manually.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent at Offer Accepted stage without credit amount populated
issues.desc: An SMS notifying the buyer of their credit amount was being triggered at the Offer Accepted stage before closing information had been submitted, resulting in the credit amount field being blank. The SMS should only send at the Sale Pending stage once the credit amount is calculated. The issue was identified as a Dash-triggered communication and escalated to product.
issues.workaround: For buyers who received the incomplete SMS during the impact window, manually send the correct buyer credit information once closing details are confirmed.

issues.title: TC Assignment workflow not re-enrolling leads whose original deal fell through — tasks not set on second Offer Accepted
issues.desc: A lead originally enrolled in the TC Assignment workflow had their deal fall through in March 2026. When the deal was updated to Offer Accepted again on April 7th, the workflow did not trigger TC tasks because re-enrollment was not enabled. The workflow was updated on May 4th to allow re-enrollment.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any deals affected by this gap (deals re-entering Offer Accepted between approximately March 16 and May 4) into the TC Assignment workflow.
